data.name: SolarTip1
data.value: PV production measured at the inverter, before the house, the battery or the car take any of it.

data.name: SolarTip2
data.value: {0} what the forecast expected the roof to be making right now, to read against the measured figure. 0 when no forecast covers this moment.

data.name: SolarTip3
data.value: {0} PV left after household consumption — the smoothed 3-minute average the solar modes decide on. Shown only while the selected mode decides on surplus.

data.name: HouseTip1
data.value: What the house is drawing apart from the car: solar plus grid import, less what the battery takes and the car draws. The same residual the Energy page calls House.

data.name: HouseTip2
data.value: A dash when the sum comes out below zero: the grid meter does not see every phase, so while the car charges part of its load can be missing from it.

data.name: BatteryTip1
data.value: Home battery power: positive while the battery charges, negative while it discharges.

data.name: BatteryTip2
data.value: The percentage is the home battery's state of charge as the inverter reports it.

data.name: CarTip
data.value: What the charger reports the car actually drawing right now — not a setpoint. Plugged in is the charger's own view of whether a vehicle is connected.

data.name: GridTip
data.value: Grid power: positive while importing from the grid, negative while exporting.

data.name: FiguresNote
data.value: Power now; under it, energy since midnight.

data.name: FiguresNoteTip
data.value: Energy since local midnight, as the energy monitor recorded it in quarter hours: a stretch the service was not running is missing from it, not estimated.

data.name: NoEnergyMonitor
data.value: Today's energy needs the energy monitor, which is off on this installation; the figures above are power now only.

data.name: NoSession
data.value: No controlled charging session is running. Pick a mode to set it up and start it on the {0} page.

data.name: LowTariffBar
data.value: The bar along the bottom is low tariff.

data.name: NoModeDriving
data.value: No mode is driving the charger, but the car is drawing: the charger reports {0}.

data.name: ChangeOrStop
data.value: Change or stop on Charging plan

data.name: DrawingNow
data.value: drawing now; no session energy counted yet

data.name: ControlStateTip
data.value: What charge control is doing right now: Disabled (nothing running), Idle (running but not acting, usually because the charger is no longer in Fast), Charging, or Paused.

data.name: ChargerStatusTip
data.value: The charger's own reported state, straight from its register.

data.name: SessionEnergyTip
data.value: Energy delivered to the car since it was plugged in. Starts afresh when it's unplugged.

data.name: EvCurrentTip
data.value: Charging current derived from the charger's measured power: what the car really takes.

data.name: TargetCurrentTip
data.value: The current the controller decided on this cycle, before it was written. Blank whenever it isn't charging.

data.name: ActiveCurrentTip
data.value: The charger's setpoint read back from the hardware: what it was actually left at.

data.name: LoanPowerTip
data.value: How much of what the car is drawing right now is covered by the home battery rather than by live sun. Zero outside the Forecasted mode.

data.name: ReadingTip
data.value: The age is how long ago the car itself produced this reading — not when we received it. Hours old is normal for a parked car; days old means the feed has died.

data.name: NoReadingYet
data.value: {0} has not delivered a reading yet — {1}

data.name: NoFeed
data.value: No feed is configured for this car, so there is no reading — nothing is wrong. Charging works in kilowatt-hours either way; a feed only adds the car's own view of itself.

data.name: NothingToAsk
data.value: No feed is configured for this car, so there is nothing to ask.

data.name: NotAskedYet
data.value: The battery and range are not shown until you ask for them. A reading can be hours behind the car, and a figure nobody requested is a figure nobody checked the age of.

data.name: CarBatteryTip1
data.value: The car's own state of charge, as its cloud integration last reported it. Not the home battery.

data.name: CarBatteryTip2
data.value: Range is what the car reckons is left in it, off its own recent consumption. Nothing here plans on it; it says whether the charge you are about to ask for is enough.

data.name: PluggedInTip1
data.value: {0} whether a vehicle is plugged in, as the charger sees it. Says nothing about whether it is drawing power.

data.name: PluggedInTip2
data.value: {0} whether the car says a cable is in its socket. A separate reading from the charger's own status, and a much slower one.

data.name: ChargeStateTip
data.value: What the car says it is doing: Idle, Charging, Complete, or Unknown when it doesn't report.

data.name: ForecastTip1
data.value: Energy in kWh, peak power in kW. Each row is a whole day, midnight to midnight in {0} time. Today's includes the hours already gone, as last forecast before they happened, so it is what the day was expected to bring rather than what is still to come.

data.name: ForecastTip2
data.value: {0} is Solcast's median: as likely to be beaten as missed.

data.name: ForecastTip3
data.value: {0} is the cautious figure, one the day should beat about nine times in ten — the Forecasted mode plans on this band by default.

data.name: ForecastTip4
data.value: {0} is the hopeful one, beaten only about one time in ten; the wider the gap between the two, the less sure the sky.

data.name: ForecastTip5
data.value: {0} is the strongest half hour the median expects, before the house takes its share — a quick check on whether the roof will make enough to charge the car at all.

data.name: ForecastTip6
data.value: Solcast is asked again every few hours in daylight, so tomorrow's figures keep moving until the day arrives. A dash means no forecast is held for that day yet.

data.name: ForecastTip7
data.value: {0} has the same two days period by period — a day total and a day's shape are different things, and this is the total.

data.name: HoldArmedAt
data.value: armed on the inverter, holding at {0}

data.name: HoldOff
data.value: the battery serves the house as usual

data.name: CarSaysIsNot
data.value: the car says it is not

data.name: Off
data.comment: The battery discharge hold is off.

data.name: NoWindow
data.comment: No charging window in today's plan.

data.name: IntoCar
data.value: into the car since it was plugged in

data.name: IntoCarWithSoc
data.value: into the car since it was plugged in; the car last said {0}
data.comment: {0} is the car's own state of charge, a percentage.

data.name: UpdatedAgo
data.comment: {0} is how old the car's reading is ("12 min", "3.5 h").

data.name: UpdatedAgoVia
data.comment: {1} is the name of the feed the reading came from.

data.name: DryRun
data.value: Dry run: decisions are logged, nothing is written to the charger.

data.name: ModeNamedUntilFull
data.comment: {0} is a charge mode's name, {1} which day of a multi-day charge it is.

data.name: DrawingNoMode
data.value: The car is drawing {0} with no mode driving the charger — the charger started it on its own.

data.name: LentByBattery
data.value: , {0} of it lent by the home battery
data.comment: Appended to ChargingInMode as its {2}; starts with a comma.

data.name: ChargingInMode
data.comment: {1} is ModeNamed, {2} is LentByBattery or nothing.

data.name: PluggedNotCharging
data.value: A car is plugged in, but nothing is charging: no mode is driving the charger.

data.name: NothingCharging
data.value: Nothing is charging, and no car is plugged in.

data.name: WaitingForCar
data.value: {0} is on, waiting for a car to be plugged in.

data.name: StoodDownUntil
data.value: {0} is on and has stood the charger down until {1}.

data.name: StoodDownTomorrow
data.value: {0} is on and has stood the charger down until tomorrow's sun.

data.name: StoodDownUntilCan
data.value: {0} is on and has stood the charger down until it can charge.

data.name: PausedCar
data.value: {0} is on and has paused the car.

data.name: NotActing
data.value: {0} is on but not acting on the charger.

data.name: NotDrawing
data.value: {0} is on; the car is not drawing power.

data.name: HighTariffUntil
data.value: High tariff until {0:HH:mm}; it is waiting for low tariff (low tariff only).

data.name: HighTariffWaiting
data.value: High tariff; it is waiting for low tariff (low tariff only).

data.name: LowTariffIgnored
data.value: Low tariff only is set, but there is no tariff to wait for, so it charges whatever the hour.
